title: Smoky Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, keto-friendly stew made with smoky lamb and a rich broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb in batches until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the smoky broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
